_comment: Manifest consumed by lib/preflight.sh. Edit here, not in the script, to add/remove tools. required=true means required regardless of project type; required_for=[frontend|backend] means required only for that type. autoinstall keys follow `${os_family}_${package_manager}` (linux_apt, darwin_brew, windows_winget, windows_scoop, etc.). `any_npm` is a universal fallback for things installable via npm.

git.manual_guide_note: git is a hard prerequisite. Install before running this script.

bash.manual_guide_note: On Windows: install Git for Windows (bundles Git Bash). On Linux/Mac: already present.

autoinstall.linux_apt: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

jq.manual_guide_note: jq parses this manifest and reads Claude settings. Hard dep.

python3.manual_guide_note: Used by .claude/settings.json hooks to JSON-encode stdout for Claude Code.

autoinstall.linux_apt: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_lts.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs

npm.manual_guide_note: npm ships with node — install node and npm will be present.

java.manual_guide_note: Install Temurin JDK 21+ (or your project's target version).

docker.manual_guide_note: Needed for Testcontainers and local compose. Install Docker Desktop on Windows/Mac, docker engine on Linux. On Windows, switch context to desktop-linux after install (see docs/troubleshooting.md).

claude.manual_guide_note: Claude Code CLI. Required to use agents, skills, hooks.

claude_globals._comment: Files and resources that MUST exist in ~/.claude/ for this project's CLAUDE.md to work as intended. The installer does NOT create these — they're user-level and cross-project.

files.note: Global user-level CLAUDE.md with universal preferences (testing standard, etc.).
Global permissions, enabled plugins, default model.
Referenced by project CLAUDE.md. If missing, the project's testing-standard link will 404.

agents._comment: Checked as files under ~/.claude/agents/<name>.md. Missing agents don't fail preflight — they just disable related workflows.

plugins._comment: Recommended plugins enabled via ~/.claude/settings.json > enabledPlugins. Missing plugins don't fail preflight — they just disable related commands.
